idea-plugin.name: PostHog Toolkit (Community)
idea-plugin.description:
See your PostHog feature flags right next to the code that uses them.

Shows each flag's status inline after flag checks in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java and Kotlin, and warns about flag keys that don't exist in your PostHog project. Works in every JetBrains IDE, including the free editions.

This is a community project and is not an official PostHog product. It is a port of PostHog's VS Code extension.
